KFC India's Moksh Chopra moves to lead Taco Bell International markets

Moksh Chopra, formerly the General Manager of KFC India, has transitioned to a new role as Market Lead for Taco Bell International, overseeing the Indian subcontinent. His responsibilities will include strategy and growth across India, Sri Lanka, and Kuwait. The move is effective September 7. Chopra previously managed KFC India and partner countries.
